mapper.sql: id, user_id, model_name, usage_date, chat_count_used, last_chat_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_daily_usage (user_id, model_name, usage_date, chat_count_used, last_chat_time) VALUES (#{userId}, 'STANDARD', #{usageDate}, 1, #{lastChatTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chat_count_used = chat_count_used + 1, last_chat_time = #{lastChatTime}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_daily_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY usage_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_daily_usage (user_id, model_name, usage_date, chat_count_used, last_chat_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{modelName}, #{usageDate}, 1, #{lastChatTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chat_count_used = chat_count_used + 1, last_chat_time = #{lastChatTime}
